chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Bukayr, he said: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
"Whoever kills with anything, small or great, after doing so intentionally, then qiṣāṣ is upon him."

key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ صَغِيرٍ أَوْ كَبِيرٍ: with anything, whether small or large in size or apparent severity
key_terms.ٱلْقَوَدُ: retaliatory retribution; qiṣāṣ for intentional killing

ai.seo_question: Does intentional killing with a small object also require qiṣāṣ in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning intentional killing. It establishes that when a person deliberately kills another, regardless of whether the instrument used is small or large, he is liable to qiṣāṣ (retaliatory retribution).
